title: Cookie & Local Storage Policy | Lalitpur Advisory
metaDescription: Information regarding the use of cookies and local browser storage on Lalitpur Financial Advisory website. Zero tracking cookies policy.
directAnswer: Lalitpur Financial Advisory uses minimal, essential client-side browser storage (such as LocalStorage and SessionStorage) solely to facilitate responsive Single Page Application navigation and preserve local calculator calculations during your active visit. We do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Technical Team

sections.contentHtml: We do not deploy intrusive third-party cross-site tracking cookies, behavioral tracking scripts, or advertising pixels. Your interactions with our calculators remain entirely within your local browser and are never uploaded to advertising servers.

cta.headline: Questions About Our Technical Policy?
cta.subtext: Contact our technical team with any inquiries.
